:::

[]{.fragment .fi-frag id="fp3-frag-geom"}

[]{.fragment .fi-frag id="fp3-frag-theme"}

```{=html}
<script>
window.FP3_CONFIG = {
  stageId:      'fp3-stage',
  markerClass:  'fp3-slide',
  fragmentIds:  ['fp3-frag-geom', 'fp3-frag-overlay', 'fp3-frag-labs', 'fp3-frag-theme'],
  ticker:       'SPY',
  geom:         'line',
  overlay:      { type: 'bbands', window: 12, mult: 2, color: '#325D88' },
  layers:       ['geom', 'overlay', 'labs', 'theme'],
  xDomain:      [0, 119],
  yDomain:      [150, 620],
  xBreaks:      [0, 24, 48, 72, 96, 119],
  yBreaks:      [200, 300, 400, 500, 600],
  xMinor:       [12, 36, 60, 84, 108],
  yMinor:       [250, 350, 450, 550],
  colors:       ['#2A4E72'],
  labs: {
    title: 'SPY — Bollinger bands (12-mo, ±2σ)',
    x:     'Months since Jan 2015',
    y:     'USD',
    color: ''
  },
  legend:       true,
  legendEntries: [
    { label: 'SPY close',   color: '#2A4E72' },
    { label: 'SMA(12)',     color: '#325D88', dashed: true },
    { label: '±2σ envelope', color: '#325D88' }
  ],
  codeHtml:
    '<span data-blk="base"><span class="gg-fn">ggplot</span>(spy, <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(date, close)) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="geom">  <span class="gg-fn">geom_line</span>(<span class="gg-arg">colour</span> = <span class="gg-str">"#2A4E72"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="overlay">  <span class="gg-fn">geom_bbands</span>(\n' +
    '    <span class="gg-fn">aes</span>(<span class="gg-arg">high</span> = high, <span class="gg-arg">low</span> = low,\n' +
    '        <span class="gg-arg">close</span> = close),\n' +
    '    <span class="gg-arg">ma_fun</span> = SMA, <span class="gg-arg">sd</span> = <span class="gg-num">2</span>, <span class="gg-arg">n</span> = <span class="gg-num">12</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="labs">  <span class="gg-fn">labs</span>(<span class="gg-arg">title</span> = <span class="gg-str">"SPY Bollinger bands"</span>,\n' +
    '       <span class="gg-arg">y</span> = <span class="gg-str">"USD"</span>) +</span>\n' +
    '<span data-blk="theme">  <span class="gg-fn">theme_tq</span>()</span>'
};
</script>
```
